title: The U.S. Military Wants A.I. Dominance. Feuds and China May Thwart It.
partialText: The administration is veering wildly in its response to the national security implications of A.I. as China, America’s main technological and military rival, charges ahead.

title: Trump’s Other Hold on the Americas: The Visa
partialText: As part of its expansionist approach to the Western Hemisphere, the Trump administration is trying to reassert its dominance, one U.S. visa at a time.

title: Years of Trump Support Came Undone in 15 Minutes in an Airport.
partialText: The case represents a new front in President Trump’s mass deportation drive: arrests at airports of people who have active immigration cases and no criminal history.

title: Is the Democratic Party Facing Its Own Tea Party Moment?
partialText: A string of primary wins by progressive candidates has revealed the strength of a high-energy insurgent movement but also its potential limitations.

title: How Republicans Embraced Brandon Herrera, a Texas Republican Candidate and Gun Influencer
partialText: Brandon Herrera, long an anti-establishment outsider, is trying to help the party defend a red-leaning House district in West Texas. It’s proving messy.

title: As Iran War Turns Into Economic Battle, a New U.S. Strategy Recalls Old Ones
partialText: The United States and Iran are poised to blow past a deadline they had set themselves to broker terms on peace and Iran’s nuclear program.

title: How a False Nuclear Claim About Iran Ricocheted From India to Washington
partialText: A dubious post that spread on X became the basis of false claims that Iran’s leadership had declared it a nuclear power.

title: With Priests Scarce in Rural Italy, an African Pastor Is Filling the Void
partialText: Immigrants have long eased labor shortages on farms and factories in Italy. But churches also need foreign-born priests, like the Rev. Vincent Souly of the Ivory Coast.

title: As the Old Files Open, One Family Confronts Another’s Dark Nazi Past
partialText: A woman who secured the criminal file of her grandmother, a collaborator, offered to share it with a Jewish family that had been betrayed. Then she balked and a new dispute ensued.

title: He’s Awkward. He’s Sticky. He’s the Best Superhero.
partialText: If you want or need any superhero right now, you’re better off with Spider-Man.

title: What’s Happening in Kansas Should Alarm Us All
Bot Meets Bot
partialText: Are we ready for a world where machines are mostly talking to each other?

title: How a Ukrainian Bank Worker Came to Face Life in a Russian Prison
partialText: Artem Murdid, his mother and his girlfriend are accused of terrorism. They say they did nothing wrong.
